description: This file defines the FileStorage class for managing file uploads and downloads, including encryption, cancellation, and event handling within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: FileStorage
classes.description: A class for managing file uploads, downloads, encryption, and cancellation with event notifications within the Notesnook project.

methods.name: queueDownloads
methods.description: Queues multiple files for download, manages download groups, and triggers download operations with event notifications.

methods.name: queueUploads
methods.description: Queues multiple files for upload, manages upload groups, and triggers upload operations with event notifications.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a specific file within a group, with duplicate detection and event notifications.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels all ongoing uploads and downloads within a specified group, and publishes cancellation events.

methods.name: readEncrypted
methods.description: Reads and decrypts an encrypted file with specified encryption key and cipher metadata.

methods.name: writeEncryptedBase64
methods.description: Encrypts data and writes it as a Base64 string with specified MIME type.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file locally or from remote storage, with optional local-only deletion.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists in storage.

methods.name: hashBase64
methods.description: Generates a Base64 hash of the provided data.

methods.name: getUploadedFileSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of an uploaded file.
